subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has numbers 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 and 9 on its sides. Two different positions of the same dice are shown below. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having 3. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79308fc3a88de7174057582c71860a6abf4c86ccb3403a79c636eafc7fb77961.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 9 is common on both the dice, it is clear that 5, 3, 4, and 2 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., 8 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65296b2b36c6536ce8e811840c8ef2ade1610382cc251bb4e98d4d111d0b0d1b.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 4

5 → 2

9 → 8

So, the opposite side of "3" will be side "4".

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
